scope: Developer skills only; prompts are fixtures, not executed Claude activation proof

cases.prompt: Using a disposable nonproduction QA tenant and isolated browser profile in ipix-open, verify the real signed-in Bot conversation: send a message, observe streaming, refresh and prove the conversation is restored, recording browser network and console evidence.
cases.expected: Inspects the existing browser test harness, refuses shared staging, requires an isolated nonproduction QA actor, verifies UI/network/reload behavior and marks unavailable runtime proof NOT VERIFIED.

cases.prompt: Read the code and fix a spelling mistake in a backend-only TypeScript comment; no browser or client application behavior changes.
cases.expected: Avoids activating browser journey testing for a backend documentation-only correction.

cases.prompt: In ipix-open, the Bot stream sometimes stops after the first tool result. Reproduce with the smallest existing test, isolate the root cause, make a minimal fix and prove retry does not create two saved shoots.
cases.expected: Finds a reproducible RED test, traces installed source, runs the corrected GREEN test and checks idempotent persistence without claiming unrun integrations.

cases.prompt: Brainstorm three campaign slogans for a sustainable clothing brand; there is no bug, failing test or implementation change.
cases.expected: Does not activate root-cause debugging for open-ended creative ideation.
